requested_outcome: Desktop search selections navigate immediately while mobile preserves the staged location, date and party flow.
natural_destination: VII search surfaces for vacations, events, spa and hourly rooms on desktop and mobile.
authorization_boundary: Local source changes and verification are authorized. Publication is not authorized by this correction alone.

lesson_bundle.reason: The correction changes shared discovery state and navigation behavior.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Search state and destination URLs must stay coherent across all worlds.

lesson_bundle.reason: Adir explicitly distinguishes the mobile staged journey from desktop immediate navigation.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Mobile must be tested as its own journey, including transitions between location, dates and party.

lesson_bundle.reason: SearchBox is shared by multiple public routes and modes.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The exact correction and the full affected family require regression evidence before completion.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The desktop fix also changes the accepted mobile staged flow.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Gate immediate navigation behind the desktop breakpoint and explicitly test mobile transitions.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: At 390 pixels, selecting a location opens the date stage and does not navigate.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A date-triggered desktop search navigates with the previous date because React state has not committed yet.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Pass the confirmed date selection directly into the search URL builder.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The generated desktop destination contains the newly confirmed date values.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The behavior is fixed for vacations but remains inconsistent in events, spa or hourly rooms.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Inventory all SearchBox modes and cover each mode in the responsive contract test.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Vacation, event, spa and hourly callbacks all use the same responsive navigation boundary.

affected_family: vacation location, date and party flow
event location, date and participant flow
spa location, date and audience flow

sources.label: Adir correction: immediate navigation is desktop-only and mobile keeps the prior staged flow

midpoint_gate.trigger: After extracting the responsive decision and updating one location selection path.
checks: Confirmed dates are passed directly rather than read from stale state

attack_questions: Can any mobile location selection still call search immediately?
Can a desktop date confirmation navigate with stale dates?
Do any of the four search modes bypass the responsive boundary?
Does resizing across the breakpoint retain a locked mobile overlay?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Rendered desktop and 390-pixel mobile search journeys on the exact candidate.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused automated tests and build evidence for all four SearchBox modes.

effectiveness.baseline: Before correction, chooseLocation and several option callbacks invoked search unconditionally on every viewport.
effectiveness.target: No immediate mobile navigation and no stale-date desktop navigation in the complete shared family.
